resources.string: Long break after every N work rounds (1–20)
Breaks occur only between work rounds. The last work round ends the session. Editing this setup does not change an active session.
Enter whole numbers within the ranges shown.
The existing session will end and the setup shown will start from its first work round. This cannot be undone.
The current progress will be cleared and its scheduled alert cancelled. Your setup fields will stay unchanged.
Could not update the session. Check the current state before trying again.

Leaving this screen does not pause the session. Android may delay background alerts because of battery or alarm restrictions. Reopening catches up to the current phase; it does not restart missed phases. This is not a safety-critical alarm.
Allow notifications for phase alerts. A session can still run without permission, but notifications may not appear. Notification and alarm settings can also block or delay alerts.
Notifications are currently unavailable or disabled. Do not rely on an audible or visible background alert.
A device restart or clock discontinuity interrupted this session. Start a new session explicitly; it will not resume automatically.
Only the current session is kept locally for recovery. This tool does not add history, presets or Workbench records.
Exact alarms are not available. Phase alerts may arrive late; the timer still catches up when reopened.
The background alert could not be scheduled. Keep this screen open or use another alarm you trust.
